generalCriterionList.description: Tenders from Joint ventures are acceptable.

Bidders shall not be under a declaration of ineligibility for
 corrupt and fraudulent practices issued by Government of Karnataka

The bidder is required to ensure browser compatibility of the computer well in advance to the last date and time for receipt of tenders. The departments shall not be responsible for non-accessibility of e-Procurement portal due to internet connectivity issues and technical glitches at bidders end.

It shall be the responsibility of the Bidder to ensure credit of Tender Processing Fee and EMD into the respective receiving bank accounts of e-Procurement on or before the last date and time of bid submission.
EMD Payments through e-Payment mode shall be made as one single transaction and payments made in part are liable for rejection.
The payment and validity period in technical bid B & D should be same.
The document submitted by bidder in KPP Portal shall not be in corrupted/damaged/protected format.
If price bid is submitted in technical bid, then EMD will be FORFEITED and your offer will be REJECTED.
Bidder shall give undertaking that they have accepted our terms regarding Delivery/Completion, Validity & Payment as per format enclosed
Bidders shall upload all the Documents in PDF format only.

As per the Government Orders vide FD 417 EXP-12-2024 dated: 09-08-2024, the bidder shall quote his rates exclusive of GST and inclusive of all Other applicable taxes, levies, duties, Cess etc. in the Kppp portal dashboard.
Since the work is of urgent nature and important for Mine production, the successful bidder should start the work within 30 days from the date of issue of LOI.
All other terms and conditions as per the NIT.

technicalCriterionList.description: The tenderer must have experience in carrying out similar type of development work as contained in this tender i.e. mine development/stope preparation work for an Underground metal mine.
Should have completed execution of similar type of work of at least worth Rs. 10 Cr. in a 12 calendar months in any one of the last five financial years (2020-21, 2021-22, 2022-23, 2023-24, 2024-25).
The tenderer must have adequate skill, experience and facilities for executing the type of work herein contained and for which they shall be tendering.

The Tenderer must be capable of satisfying the Company as to their technical competence to execute this work. A list of similar work undertaken with the quantity and value and delay (if any) shall be enclosed. The tenderer should also submit the performance certificate from the party where the job was undertaken about the technical competence and job undertaken in the last five years (2020-21, 2021-22, 2022-23, 2023-24, 2024-25).

The bidder in any one of the last five financial years (2020-21, 2021-22, 2022-23, 2023-24, 2024-25) should have achieved in at least two Financial year, the turnover per annum not less than the Rs.10 Crore. The turnover certificate, to this effect, issued by the Chartered Accountant shall be enclosed.
Only such Tenderers who have performed the work as specified in the scheduled Scope of Work, as a principal Contractor or as partner of a Consortium will be eligible to participate in this Tender

The tenderer must have adequate financial and commercial capability to undertake execution of a work of the type and magnitude as the work tendered and the documentary evidences in this regard shall be submitted in their techno-commercial offer.

The employees of the Company and their dependents/relatives are debarred from Offering the bids/submitting the tender either directly or indirectly. A declaration to this effect shall be submitted along with the offer.
Copies of Income Tax Returns for each of the FY 2022-23, 2023-24, 2024-25 to be submitted.
Turn-over certificate, P&L and Balance sheet duly certified by Chartered Accountant for the FY 2020-21, 2021-22, 2022-23, 2023-24, 2024-25.

itemList.description: Level development of 3m (w) x 3m (h) size- Development of drives and cross cut at various levels/sub-levels including drilling, blasting, muck removal & transporting to bin or to a designated location in underground. This also includes Roof bolting as per approved SSR, fixing of pipe lines for compressed air and water line, track line extension, maintaining proper drainage and providing adequate ventilation as per statute etc.

Vertical Development of 2.5m x 2.5m size- Development of Drop Raise at designated locations in underground mine by long hole drilling and blasting method, using suitable long hole drilling machines, including drilling of long holes as per approved drilling pattern, charging and blasting, muck removal and transportation to bin or designated location in underground.

Ladder way equipping in Drop Raise upto 2.5m x 2.5m size- Providing and equipping a safe and permanent ladderway in the developed drop raise, including installation and fixing of ladders, ladder way supports, platforms, landings, handrails and other necessary accessories at specifies intervals. The work shall include Rock bolting as per approved SSR, proper anchoring, alignment and securing of the ladderway to ensure safe access and egress throughout the Drop raise as per the approved design and applicable provisions of the MMR, 1961.
Side/ Roof Stripping of Drive / Cross cut wherever required and other miscellaneous excavation.
